rule:
PhysioMix crop_r1 rule (validation only; locked criterion sha256 813c4dd12e7e878dcc29b4f153524d41ad0bcfbef38ad62708aa4bf6ab7086d0).
Arm L3_rel_beat_lr_crop_r1 = round-4 winner L3_rel_beat_lr with a 240-sample cropped output and the critic clip on lazy-R1 steps scaled x16 (10 -> 160), same seeds, steps and learning-rate schedule as round 4; every round-3 gate unchanged.
Incumbent: round3_physiomix_v2, S_arm [0.5786631538990534, 0.5822552091758637, 0.6259113024743039], S_real [0.37724536685135757, 0.3394293098960376, 0.38247588889461326] (mean S_arm 0.5956).
Ship the crop arm only if every seed passes the round-3 gates, its mean S_arm beats the incumbent by more than the pooled seed SD and its mean S_real is at most the incumbent's + 0.05; the shipped seed is its lowest-S_arm seed. Otherwise the incumbent stays. The GXU test is scored only after this decision is saved.
